info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Airline Flights Miles-v3-spec
info.description: The Airline Flight Miles Retrieval API enables users to access comprehensive data on airline flight mileage. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve information regarding various airline flights and their corresponding miles. It is particularly beneficial for travel agencies, airline partners, and loyalty program managers who need to analyze and track flight performance based on mileage. By leveraging this API, users can gain insights to optimize customer offers and improve travel planning.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access information about accumulated flight miles. It provides details on the total miles earned and how they can be utilized for redeeming rewards or benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about flight miles. It is expected to contain the necessary parameters for the request in JSON format.
